source_basis.finding: kpc_get_curthread_counters returns the current thread's accumulated KPC buffer; the pinned Stax parser and pipeline forwarded each sampled vector as if it were an interval delta

method: Apply the proposed core-identity patch, then run a rootless fake daemon that emits invented cumulative PET/PMC snapshots at successive ticks. Capture the same real M1 Metal target with a core-ID-only Stax server and a server additionally patched for per-thread differencing. No root helper or hardware PMU collection was used.

topdown_after_patch_import.pmu_counter_semantics: unverified because v3 does not record conversion provenance

checks.stax_parser_library_tests: 7 passed, including per-thread differencing and reset/vector-change rebasing

limitations: The PET records and PMU values are synthetic; the control demonstrates Stax software behavior, not actual M1 hardware counter values or installed-kernel PET semantics. The proposed patch is not installed upstream. A per-thread delta can include work on several CPUs between ticks and must not be attributed entirely to the trace CPU ID. Stax v3 lacks an explicit PMU-semantics provenance marker, so an importer cannot distinguish patched from unpatched archives. Native record loss and thread-ID reuse remain unvalidated.
